overview: A minimal full-viewport landing page that declares "Still On." with an interactive light bulb that toggles both its own on/off state and the page's light/dark theme. A quiet tagline sits in the bottom-right corner.
features: Interactive light bulb that toggles on/off visually
Light/dark theme switch tied to bulb state
Footer tagline: When the rest of the web is down. Built with Caffeine. Powered by ICP.
